notes: Two isnads for the one saying: the first ends at Nafi, the second («قال أصحابنا عن المكي») runs through an unnamed group of companions to Ibn Umar, where the saying is reported
«أصحابنا» is an unnamed link; «المكي» in the second route is the second occurrence of the word, the first being the full name
The Prophet is the end; «رضى الله عنهما» is left out
